answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a gatekeeper for AI agents, requiring capital commitment to validate network transactions. By tethering influence to asset ownership, the system creates a ripple effect where cost-to-attack scales linearly with stake. A Sybil spiral is mitigated because each fake identity requires its own locked capital, turning the network into a reef of immutable security. The attacker must acquire massive tokens, making the economic cost of identity multiplication strictly prohibitive.
